fact: The online company-creation platform Orinasa has been accessible in Manakara since July 2025, per the EDBM antenna head.

EDBM opened a regional antenna in Manakara in May 2026, and company-registration services there now rest on collaboration between the Tribunal de Premiere Instance, Instat, the regional tax directorate and EDBM.

The finance ministry says the RCBE has moved from technical build to effective use of the beneficial-owner data recorded on the platform, after four data-sharing protocols signed by the DGI on Friday 18 September 2026.
The DGI's Registre Central des Beneficiaires Effectifs was officially launched on 16 June 2026 to identify the beneficial owners of legal persons and legal structures, per the finance ministry.
